notes: Caller for the repo's reusable %HSF_Px High-Sensitivity-Filter macro. Mock cohort/encounter/code-list datasets (built in autoexec) satisfy the column shapes the macro reads (PatID, ADATE/encounter date, ENCTYPE, code, code-list desc). The macro's full relative-risk PROC SQL pipeline runs unchanged; only the environment-specific ODS EXCEL export tail (Windows path) was rewritten to a portable PROC PRINT of the same result table.
